Role Overview
Cognizant is seeking an experienced Knowledge Graph Data Engineer to build and operate the connectivity, profiling, and graph/search foundation that powers enterprise ontology and knowledge management platforms.
In this role, you will be responsible for transforming raw operational and master data sources into clean, lineage-tracked, governed, and queryable knowledge assets. You will design and support data connectivity, metadata management, graph platforms, ingestion frameworks, and search capabilities that enable scalable knowledge discovery and enterprise intelligence solutions.
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), data engineering, metadata management, graph technologies, data lineage, and scalable ingestion architectures.
Work Model
This position is fully remote within the United States , providing flexibility while collaborating with globally distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Occasional travel may be required for client workshops, planning sessions, architecture reviews, and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Data Connectivity & Integration
+ Design, develop, and maintain connectivity solutions for enterprise data sources.
+ Build adapters and integration frameworks supporting:
+ BigQuery
+ Cloud SQL
+ REST APIs
+ Apigee
+ Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
+ Pub/Sub
+ Establish scalable and reliable ingestion patterns for operational, transactional, and master data systems.
+ Support API-based integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms.
Data Profiling & Metadata Management
+ Profile enterprise data to assess:
+ Data Quality
+ Completeness
+ Statistical Patterns
+ Dependencies
+ Data Relationships
+ Source System Characteristics
+ Develop data discovery frameworks that support ontology and semantic model development.
+ Build metadata management processes supporting data governance, traceability, and analytics.
+ Surface data quality issues and metadata findings to architecture and business teams.
Knowledge Graph & Search Platform Engineering
+ Design and operate the enterprise Knowledge Core supporting graph-based data exploration and search.
+ Implement graph and knowledge management platforms utilizing:
+ Spanner Graph
+ Neo4j
+ Amazon Neptune
+ TigerGraph
+ RDF/SPARQL Technologies
+ Equivalent Graph Platforms
+ Support graph data modeling, relationship management, and semantic search capabilities.
+ Enable enterprise-scale graph analytics and knowledge discovery use cases.
Batch & Streaming Data Engineering
+ Build and maintain batch and real-time data pipelines that continuously synchronize source data with graph and catalog platforms.
+ Design ingestion architectures utilizing:
+ Dataflow
+ Apache Beam
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Event-Driven Architectures
+ Ensure data pipelines remain scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
+ Support near real-time updates across ontology and knowledge graph environments.
Data Governance, Quality & Lineage
+ Implement automated data quality controls and validation frameworks.
+ Support schema discovery and metadata catalog capabilities.
+ Capture and maintain end-to-end data lineage from source systems through graph and ontology representations.
+ Establish governance controls including:
+ IAM Policies
+ Encryption Standards
+ Metadata Tracking
+ Lineage Instrumentation
+ Partner with architecture and governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.
Ontology & AI Enablement
+ Support ontology mapping activities by providing:
+ Profiled Schemas
+ Data Dependency Maps
+ Sample Data Sets
+ Metadata Context
+ Deliver curated and well-profiled datasets supporting machine learning and entity-resolution initiatives.
+ Collaborate with Data Scientists and Applied AI teams to improve data quality and knowledge graph accuracy.
+ Enable graph-based AI use cases, entity matching, semantic search, and inference capabilities.
Monitoring, Reliability & Optimization
+ Monitor platform health, ingestion jobs, graph-processing workloads, and metadata services.
+ Troubleshoot data and pipeline issues and implement preventative solutions.
+ Optimize performance, scalability, and operational efficiency across the platform stack.
+ Manage cost optimization initiatives across cloud infrastructure and processing workloads.
Required Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
+ 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Platform Engineering.
+ Proven experience building large-scale ingestion, metadata, and data management solutions.
+ Strong expertise in:
+ Python
+ SQL
+ Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including:
+ BigQuery
+ Dataflow
+ Pub/Sub
+ Cloud Composer
+ Cloud SQL
+ Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
+ Experience implementing:
+ Data Profiling
+ Data Lineage
+ Metadata Management
+ Data Quality Frameworks
+ Experience with graph technologies, including one or more of:
+ Spanner Graph
+ Neo4j
+ Amazon Neptune
+ TigerGraph
+ JanusGraph
+ RDF/SPARQL Platforms
+ Experience writing graph queries using:
+ Cypher
+ Gremlin
+ SPARQL
+ Equivalent Graph Query Languages
+ Strong understanding of data governance and metadata management principles.
+ Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
+ Hands-on experience with Spanner Graph.
+ Experience within telecommunications environments.
+ Knowledge of:
+ OSS/BSS Systems
+ TM Forum SID
+ eTOM Frameworks
+ Experience with Apigee or enterprise API management platforms.
+ Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer Certification.
+ Experience building semantic search, knowledge graph, or ontology-based solutions.
+ Familiarity with vector search technologies and retrieval architectures.
+ Experience supporting AI, knowledge management, or graph-powered analytics initiatives.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Lead AWS Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize enterprise-scale cloud data platforms and lakehouse solutions on AWS. This role will focus on developing high-performance data pipelines using PySpark, AWS Glue, S3, Lake Formation, Athena, Apache Iceberg, Redshift, and Aurora. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on data engineering expertise with cloud-native architecture, automation, and GitHub-based engineering practices. The position requires technical leadership across data processing, governance, performance optimization, and production-grade data platform delivery.
In this role, you will:
· Design and develop scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using AWS Glue, PySpark, S3, and cloud-native data services.
· Build modern lakehouse architectures leveraging Amazon S3, AWS Lake Formation, Apache Iceberg, Athena, and Redshift.
· Develop data ingestion, transformation, and processing frameworks using PySpark, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Kinesis, and related AWS services.
· Design and optimize analytical and transactional data solutions using Redshift and Amazon Aurora, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
· Implement data governance capabilities including access controls, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and secure data sharing through Lake Formation.
· Develop serverless data processing and integration components using AWS Lambda, APIs, EventBridge, SQS, and SNS where applicable.
· Establish CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code practices using GitHub, Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK for repeatable data platform deployments.
· Implement GitHub branching, pull request, code review, testing, and release management standards across engineering teams.
· Monitor and optimize data pipelines, storage, queries, and compute resources to improve reliability, performance, and FinOps outcomes.
· Collaborate with architects, analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders while providing technical guidance and mentoring to data engineers.
What you need to have to be considered
· 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, or enterprise data architecture.
· Expert hands-on experience with PySpark, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Athena, and Apache Iceberg.
· Strong experience with Amazon Redshift, including data modeling, query optimization, workload management, and performance tuning.
· Hands-on experience with Amazon Aurora and strong knowledge of SQL, relational data modeling, and database integration patterns.
· Strong Python development skills and experience building scalable ETL/ELT and data processing frameworks on AWS.
· Strong experience with GitHub, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, source control, and CI/CD integration.
· Working knowledge of AWS Lambda, EMR, Kinesis, Kafka, and real-time or event-driven data processing architectures.
· Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK for Infrastructure as Code and automated cloud deployments.
· Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, IAM, security, and cloud cost optimization.
· Experience with AWS VPC, IAM/SSO, KMS, networking, containers, and cloud-native architecture is desirable.

This role owns the data foundation underpinning Nelnet’s GenAI solutions for higher education and SLED clients. The Data Engineer builds and maintains the data pipelines, classification, and governance framework required to make client data safely and reliably usable by agentic AI solutions built on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Operating within Nelnet’s GenAI delivery team, this role translates the Forward Deployed Engineer’s scoped requirements into production data pipelines on Google Cloud, working closely with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer to ensure data is structured, classified, and access-controlled appropriately for AI use. Given the sensitivity of student and institutional data, this role plays a central part in surfacing data-level compliance risk — such as FERPA — before it reaches production.
Compensation range for this role: $115,000-$135,000 based on experience.
Nelnet believes in a hybrid work environment that accommodates both in-office and remote work. This model promotes a positive work-life balance and culture, enabling in-person collaboration when possible while also providing benefits associated with remote work. The standard hybrid work schedule includes 24 hours of in-office work each week, for associates that reside within 30 miles of an office. This is subject to change, based on manager discretion.
At this time, we are unable to consider external candidates that reside in these states: Alabama, California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington.
NOTE: Internal Associates working in a remote capacity may be considered
for this position.
Data Pipeline Engineering
+ Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using BigQuery and Dataflow (or Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow) to ingest, transform, and serve client data for GenAI use cases.
+ Build and maintain ELT/ETL processes for batch ingestion of client source system data (SIS, ERP, casework systems) into Google Cloud analytics and RAG data stores — distinct from the live, real-time system access the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer builds for agent tool use.
+ Monitor pipeline reliability, performance, and cost, optimizing BigQuery usage and Dataflow jobs as engagements scale.
Data Classification & AI Readiness
+ Classify and tag client data using Dataplex and Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to identify sensitive and regulated data, such as FERPA-protected student records, prior to AI use.
+ Define and enforce data access controls and governance policies appropriate for higher education and SLED data sensitivity.
+ Assess and document data readiness for AI use cases, flagging gaps in quality, completeness, or governance to the Forward Deployed Engineer.
Data Architecture & Integration
+ Design data models and schemas that support both current client use cases and reusable, repeatable data patterns across engagements.
+ Partner with client technical teams to understand source system constraints and negotiate data access and extraction approaches.
+ Maintain technical documentation of data flows, schemas, and classification decisions for internal reuse and audit purposes.
Delivery Execution & Quality
+ Execute against the delivery backlog owned by the Forward Deployed Engineer, providing technical estimates and flagging data-related delivery risks.
+ Partner with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer to ensure data pipelines feed agentic solutions with the structure and freshness required.
+ Conduct data quality reviews and testing to maintain reliability standards across the practice.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer on data structure and access needed for agentic solutions and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
+ Partner with the AgentOps Engineer on infrastructure, security, and environment management for data systems.
+ Provide technical input to the Forward Deployed Engineer and Engagement Manager on data-related scope, risk, and timeline.
EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent work experience
EXPERIENCE:

Direct experience with BigQuery and Dataflow (or Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow) strongly preferred; candidates with strong GenAI/AI-adjacent data engineering experience on other platforms who can ramp quickly on Google Cloud will be considered.
+ Experience with data governance and classification tooling for identifying and managing sensitive or regulated data (e.g., Google Cloud Dataplex and Cloud DLP, or equivalent tools such as Collibra, Alation, AWS Macie); direct experience with Google's tools strongly preferred.
+ Working knowledge of cloud storage, messaging, and access-control concepts (e.g., Cloud Storage/S3, Pub/Sub/SNS/SQS, IAM) sufficient to ramp quickly on Google Cloud's specific implementations.
+ Google Cloud certification preferred (Professional Data Engineer), demonstrating hands-on technical fluency; foundational/business-oriented certifications do not satisfy this preference.
+ Strong SQL skills and experience with Python for pipeline development and data transformation.
+ Familiarity with data privacy and compliance considerations relevant to education or public sector data (e.g., FERPA, state privacy law).
+ Experience partnering with client or partner technical teams to extract and integrate data from legacy or third-party systems (SIS, ERP, casework systems).
+ Ability to work from a scoped backlog and translate technical requirements from the Forward Deployed Engineer into working data pipelines.
Desired Competencies:
+ Demonstrates strong technical judgment in structuring data for both immediate client use and long-term reuse.
+ Identifies data quality, access, and compliance risks proactively before they affect delivery or client trust.
+ Communicates technical data considerations clearly to non-technical stakeholders and the Forward Deployed Engineer.
+ Builds for reuse, translating one-off client data work into repeatable technical assets.
+ Takes ownership of data reliability and quality from ingestion through AI consumption.
+ Collaborates effectively with GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineering and AgentOps counterparts.
+ Maintains composure and problem-solving focus when data quality or access blockers threaten delivery timelines.
+ Seeks continuous learning given the fast-evolving nature of the Google Cloud data and AI platform.
